recommendation.headline: Accept the claim and issue a full refund since the order was shipped without tracking and cannot be proven delivered.
recommendation.rationale: Because the $28.00 sneaker care kit was shipped via USPS First-Class envelope without tracking, we have no carrier delivery scans or proof of receipt to submit to PayPal. Under PayPal rules for item-not-received disputes, sellers must provide valid online tracking showing delivery to the buyer's address to win. Fighting this dispute is certain to fail, so issuing a full refund is the most efficient course of action.

evidence.summary: The order was shipped via USPS First-Class envelope without online tracking or delivery confirmation.
The buyer filed an inquiry stating the sneaker care kit has not arrived after three weeks.

recommendation.response_to_paypal: We apologize that the shipment did not reach you. Because this order was sent via untracked mail, we are unable to verify delivery with the carrier. We have issued a full refund of $28.00 to resolve this matter.
risks: None. A full refund successfully closes the dispute.

factors.finding: The buyer never received the item and filed an item-not-received dispute.
The order was shipped without online tracking or delivery confirmation, leaving no proof of delivery.
The disputed amount is small ($28.00), making a refund more cost-effective than fighting an indefensible claim.
